messages:
Priya Patel: Heads-up team — NebulaEdge wants to onboard their hardware accelerator into eu-south-2. We need marketplace SKUs, quota approvals, KMS entitlements, and a legal check before any joint comms. @Jordan @Mara can you own the tickets?
Jordan Lee: I can own the quota/marketplace flow. Need SKU identifiers and expected unit counts. Will open partner ticket today.
Sam Ortiz: From infra: we need exact accelerator model (H100 vs A100), firmware level, and a capacity profile (peak rps, concurrent reserved sessions). Also any special driver/firmware certs.
Priya Patel: Partner sent SKU: `neb-accel-h100-v1` and called it a "fast-path" marketplace listing. They propose 20 reserved units to start. Attaching quick quota spec below.
Priya Patel: ```
quota_request:
  region: eu-south-2
  sku: neb-accel-h100-v1
  units: 20
  purpose: dedicated-reserved (partner-managed)
```
Elena Gomez (NebulaEdge): We'll confirm the 20 units. KMS: NebulaEdge requires customer-managed keys (BYOK) for this SKU. KMS onboarding typically takes ~10 business days. We'll provide key policy and certs.
Jordan Lee: Opening partner portal ticket now: https://partner.cloud/requests/new — will include the quota block and tag it `marketplace-listing` and `nebulaedge`. ETA for ticket creation: 2h.
Mara (Legal): Please route draft joint announcement copy to legal@redwood.com. Also flagging export-control review for H100 in eu-south-2 before any public mention. No press until legal signs off.
KMSBot: KMS integration checklist: provide key policy JSON, HSM vendor, rotation schedule, and wallet proof-of-possession. Template: https://redwood.internal/kms-onboard (internal).
Priya Patel: Action items — Jordan: open quota + marketplace request & attach the code block above; Sam: confirm infra capacity profile and test plan (due in 48h); Mara: legal + export check (due in 5 business days); Elena: share KMS artifacts and firmware certs (due in 72h).
Elena Gomez (NebulaEdge): Confirmed — we'll upload key policy and firmware certs by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan Lee: Ticket created: https://tickets.redwood.com/TICK-4521 (partner: NebulaEdge). Added milestone `marketplace-listing` and linked to infra and legal.
Priya Patel: Proposed soft-launch date: 2025-03-10 (partner GTM week). Can we align? :calendar:
Sam Ortiz: Tentative ok, but autoscale and regression tests must pass. Scheduling load tests for next Tue; will update post-run.
Mara (Legal): Added export-control task to the ticket. If H100 firmware v2.x triggers additional controls, we may need an alternate SKU or delay. Looping in export-bot.
Export-bot: Alert — H100 firmware v2.0 flagged for additional export restrictions in eu-south-2. See: https://compliance.internal/export/h100. Legal should confirm.
Priya Patel: Thanks all — hold on public comms until legal and KMS greenlight. Reconvene after Jordan posts ticket updates.
Jordan Lee: Will post updates in-thread and ping @Priya when infra + legal tasks are attached.
Sam Ortiz: Noted. I'll post the capacity matrix after load test results.
Elena Gomez (NebulaEdge): We'll escalate on our side if KMS onboarding needs faster SLA.
Priya Patel: Great. Closing loop for now — next check-in tomorrow after Jordan's ticket and KMS artifact upload.
